Janel: Sable POC reporting TTFT variance during parallel client startup. Many first-token >800ms and occasional 429 on ramp to ~420 rps. Can SEs triage? :thinking_face:
Omar: pls paste sample req ids, model, route, and whether their gateway opens multiple connections per client.
Janel: route=/v1/generate model=redwood-3b-std variant=quant-s2 reqs=r_sable_a / r_sable_b / r_sable_c
Janel: clients open 3 persistent conns per instance, prefill=true, prefill_tokens=32, batch_window_ms=20
Sofia: logs attached (snippet):
Janel: ```
[2026-08-03T16:03:12.101Z] req=r_sable_a lat_ms=910 status=200 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-5
[2026-08-03T16:03:12.290Z] req=r_sable_b lat_ms=58 status=200 batch_size=18 kv_hit=true shard=shard-2
[2026-08-03T16:03:13.501Z] req=r_sable_c lat_ms=1200 status=429 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-5
```
Omar: pattern = small batch_size + kv_hit=false on slow/429 -> likely affinity loss or shard hot/cold. Can someone run `redwoodctl shard-inspect shard-5 --last 45m`?
Sofia: running now  output: kv_hit_rate=20% active_variants=[quant-s2, quant-s3] evictions_per_min=5 cpu_load=74%
Omar: mixed variants on shard-5 and low KV hit explains cold loads. Immediate mitigations: 1) enable tenant-affinity/pinning for this tenant 2) bump prefill_tokens to 128 for the POC run 3) increase batch_window_ms to 50ms to improve batching during bursts
Janel: customer also asks about cost impact and whether Dedicated is required to hit 99th percentile TTFT. They want hosted delta and Dedicated trial timing.
Pricing: ballpark hosted unit cost ~0.0010/token for this workload; small Dedicated pool estimate ~0.00058/token at ~70% utilization. Note: final depends on commit term and utilization. KMS onboarding for Dedicated ~2 weeks.
Infra-bot: action: tenant.affinity=enabled for tenant=sable; pool sable-pool add_shards=1 (rolling); kv.eviction_ttl=1800s applied :gear:
Janel: after changes customer reran tests  results: ~93% requests TTFT <100ms, a few outliers ~450-700ms, 429s disappeared. Trace id t_sable_0803_1608 provided for deep dive.
Omar: will check trace for kernel selection/fallback; if we see generic matmul fallback on slow traces escalate to runtime. If customer cannot reduce gateway connection churn, recommend short Dedicated trial.
Sofia: next steps for SE: update customer with remediation steps (keepalive pinning, bump prefill, batch window), offer Dedicated trial and pricing ballpark, and capture traces if outliers persist. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
